claim_being_audited: That certifying the model is policy-compliant because aggregate performance clears the deployment bar, provided the small-business support slice weakness and its sampling uncertainty are explicitly disclosed in the model card.
specific_concerns: The policy allows certification only if the material weakness is disclosed or an approved mitigation removes exposure, but the record provided does not show the actual disclosure artifact or a final conditioned approval tied to that disclosure.
The recommended action is stated as `certify_model`, which is broader than the narrower supported conclusion: certify only with explicit model-card disclosure.
The mitigation is only a draft and unapproved, so it cannot independently support a clean certification posture.

Materiality of the small-business support slice is treated as requiring disclosure, but the admissible record available here is only the actor summary rather than the underlying model card or approval record.
unsupported_claims: Any implication that a clean, unconditional certification is supported.
Any implication that the draft monitoring mitigation removes the disclosure obligation.
Any implication that aggregate pass rates erase the subgroup weakness.
evidence_requests: Provide the final model card or disclosure text showing the small-business support slice weakness and sampling uncertainty are explicitly disclosed.
Provide the certification approval record showing certification was conditioned on that disclosure.
Provide the underlying evidence for BMCARD-042-A through BMCARD-042-E, not just the actor's summary, to confirm the thresholds, shortfall, uncertainty, and mitigation status.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if material weaknesses are disclosed or an approved mitigation removes deployment exposure.
Aggregate pass rates can support launch readiness but do not erase subgroup weaknesses.
Small-sample uncertainty can justify follow-up monitoring but does not convert an unresolved material weakness into a clean certification.
A compliant certification decision here must be explicitly tied to disclosure, because no approved mitigation is available.
